Bambr.io is a tech company, based in Kuwait, which provides educational and consultancy services in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Programming. Operating as LearnIT Academy Kuwait, we are the leading Google for Education Premier Partner in MENA.

This is a full-time role for a Google Certified Trainer in AI for Education, based in Kuwait. The Trainer will be responsible for designing and delivering effective training sessions focused on AI concepts and their application in educational settings. Day-to-day tasks include facilitating training workshops in different districts of Kuwait, delivering online webinars, creating instructional materials, and ensuring knowledge transfer to empower educators and learners. Additionally, the Trainer will collaborate with stakeholders to assess training needs and continuously improve the program.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Must be based in Kuwait and willing to travel to different districts across the country.
Willing to travel to other countries in the region (preferred).
Must have C1 level (fluent) proficiency in Arabic and English.
Google Certified Educator – Level 1 and/or Level 2 (strongly preferred).
Experience or familiarity with Google Gemini and Notebook LM is an advantage.
Proven experience in training, teaching, or professional development.
Ability to deliver engaging, hands-on training sessions.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional excellence.
Must be willing to teach different age groups ranging from school-aged children to adults.

d: Job Title: Senior Manager_Warehousing and Distribution

This role is responsible for owning the day-to-day logistics execution across the company's operations. The role acts as the operational control point between vendors, freight providers,3PL warehouses, customer service, and internal supply chain teams, ensuring efficient stock movement, timely order processing, and clear visibility on logistics performance across wholesale, retail and marketplace channels.
q: Builder mindset – energised by setting up new processes, partners and KPIs.
Ability to lead, coach and hold partners accountable, including under pressure.
Strong written and verbal communication across cultures and time zone
Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering or related field.
6–10 years of relevant logistics operations experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial position.
Strong, hands-on track record in 3PL warehouse governance, multi-carrier transport management and shipment execution.
Demonstrated experience leading transformation, transitions or operational stand-ups.
Prior experience in fashion, luxury, footwear, retail or premium consumer goods is highly preferred.
Familiarity with ERP and WMS systems and logistics KPI reporting.
r: Own end-to-end logistics execution KPIs, including inbound OTIF, warehouse SLA, outbound dispatch performance, return rates and exception resolution time.
Lead daily and weekly operational governance with 3PL warehouse and transport partners, holding them accountable to contractual service levels.
Act as the senior escalation point for execution issues impacting customer deliveries, brand launches and marketplace performance.
Manage and develop direct reports, ensuring clear ownership and a strong execution culture.
Serve as the primary operational interface with 3PL warehouses and fulfilment partners.
Govern receiving,order processing, picking, packing, dispatch and returns handling across all 3PL sites.
Run regular performance reviews, drive corrective action plans, and lead contract renegotiation cycles where required.
Onboard new 3PL partners and new lanes, including standard operating procedures, system integration and pricing schedules.
Own the relationship with freight forwarders, carriers and courier providers across inbound and outbound flows.
Drive parcel carrier tender cycles, securing competitive rates and reliable service.
Monitor shipment schedules, transport bookings, proof of delivery, transit-time performance and exception management.
Lead freight optimisation initiatives across modes (sea, air, road) to balance cost, speed and service reliability.
Oversee the daily flow of goods from suppliers into warehouses, and from warehouses to wholesale customers, retail stores, and end consumers.
Coordinate stock transfers, urgent replenishments, and shipment prioritisation aligned to launch calendars and merchandising plans.
Ensure accurate goods-in-transit visibility and timely system updates between WMS, ERP and partner platforms.
Support stock migrations and inter-DC consolidations as required.
Lead operational management of returns, refused deliveries, shipment discrepancies and warehouse claims.
Coordinate with customer service, warehouse partners and carriers to ensure timely closure and minimal financial leakage.
Identify recurring issues and implement structural fixes through SOP changes, process redesign or partner reviews.
Own and maintain logistics dashboards covering OTIF, warehouse SLAs, dispatch lead times, return rates, claims and operational exceptions.
Provide regular operational reporting to senior management on performance, risks and improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement projects in execution discipline, automation and process efficiency.
Work closely with planning, customer service, finance, IT and commercial teams to ensure logistics execution supports business priorities.
Align shipment priorities with customer deadlines, launch calendars and replenishment plans.
Maintain clear, structured communication across internal teams and external logistics stakeholders.
